town_letter.name: Misdirected Letter
town_letter.description: Second post, Castle. Miss Dray has written the right address across the front in pencil. The postmark is next Sunday's.

town_washing.name: Washing
town_washing.description: Off Mrs Marsh's line at No. 5, High Street. It is bone dry, and it went wet.

town_cap.name: Robert's Cap
town_cap.description: A boy's cloth cap, off the peg inside the Forge door. R. HALE is written inside the band. It is still damp.

town_loaf.name: A Loaf
town_loaf.description: Mrs Oddie's, wrapped in paper, for No. 7, Pound Lane. It is still warm, and it is not for eating.
